$comment: Flasks and potions: enemies carry the flasks and throw them at the heroes (src/data/stats.json `throwables`; systems/ThrowSystem.ts); heroes carry all of them in the bag, throw any (the inventory's Throw) and drink the potions. After the D&D 5e Player's Handbook and Baldur's Gate 3. rangeFeet: how far one is thrown. radiusFeet: how wide it splashes where it lands. save and dc: the saving throw everyone in the splash makes (none for a potion). damage and damageType: what the splash deals on a failed save (none on a success). burnSeconds: how long a body that failed burns, taking burnDamage each round (6 s; standing in water puts it out). surface: what it leaves on the floor (systems/Surfaces.ts; none for a potion), surfaceSeconds how long that lasts (0: for good) and surfaceDc the save it asks of whoever enters it (grease: DEX or fall prone). Fire sets grease alight. heal: what a potion restores to whoever drinks it, and to every creature its splash wets when thrown (foes too). cost (gold), weight (kg) and icon (under public/, from scripts/download-potion-icons.py and scripts/potion-icons.sh): the item in the bag.
